programs.title: Carnival Eats
programs.desc: Noah visits the Delaware State Fair and tries the Delaware Dog, the funnel cake-filled Frankenfunnel Burger and the octopus-loaded Octotaco, along with the Killer Cereal Treat; Noah's second stop is the Obion County Fair in Union City, Tenn.

programs.title: Carnival Eats

programs.title: Carnival Eats
programs.desc: Noah visits the Wilson County Fair in Lebanon, Tenn. And tries Tennessee Hot Chicken and tastes Meme's Meatloaf Sammy; Noah enjoys the Three Little Pigs Melt and tries Buffalo Chicken Stromboli at the Pickaway County Fair in Circleville, Ohio.
